note: The Dallas County Clarity results file for the May 8, 2010 joint election (election 16612, detail.txt) lists three Irving city contests: Council Member District 01, Council Place 2 At-Large and Council Member District 7. It lists no Irving mayor contest, although it lists mayor contests for other cities. The City of Irving canvass ordinance ORD-2013-9464 states that a system of three-year alternating terms was already in place in 2013, and the mayor is elected with Places 3 and 5 in 2011, 2014, 2017 and 2020. Places 1, 2 and 7 were on the 2010 ballot. No mayoral election was held in 2010. Cycle source: Irving City Charter Art. IV Secs. 6 and 8 (three-year terms for the mayor and council, regular election in May), as published on the City of Irving website and opened through the Internet Archive.

City of Irving Ordinance ORD-2013-9464 canvasses the May 11, 2013 general municipal election held to elect Council Places 1, 2 and 7 for three-year terms. The ordinance lists no mayoral contest. Its summary of charter amendments states that the system of three-year alternating terms is already in place. No mayoral election was held in 2013. Cycle source: Irving City Charter Art. IV Secs. 6 and 8 (three-year terms for the mayor and council, regular election in May), as published on the City of Irving website and opened through the Internet Archive.
